This implies a potential mechanism by which Lamotrigine may modulate Scn9a activity, possibly through the regulation of sodium channel function. The integration of these pathways highlights a possible role for Lamotrigine in influencing the activity of Scn9a, likely through its interaction with Scn8a and the subsequent modulation of sodium channel function.
